title: Offline chat composer
blurb: Phone-first support chat composing LanguageDetector (Android M157+) and Translator (Android M161+) with a sticky safe-area composer, IME-safe Enter handling, navigator.onLine chip, honest untranslated fallback, and one-tap pack install.
question: Can a mobile chat composer chain LanguageDetector.detect() and Translator.translate() for on-device offline translation while degrading honestly to labelled untranslated messages when models are not yet installed?
result: On Chrome for Testing 153 headless (Linux), LanguageDetector resolved "unavailable" and es->en resolved "downloadable", so sent messages were cleanly labelled untranslated with an explicit per-message install button and zero console errors. Live on-device detection, translation, and Android soft-keyboard layout not verified on Chrome for Android 161.
testedIn: Chrome for Testing 153 headless (Linux, fallback and UI verified); live translation and Android virtual keyboard not verified on Chrome for Android 161
